findings.message:
[P1] Retired closed publication still cannot republish

The guard added at these lines treats `pr === null` with no intent as having no closed-publication evidence, but `retireClosedPublication` produces exactly that state after `observeReview` or `requestReviewFor` observes a preserved-null PR closed unmerged: it clears `target.pr` and the review intent while leaving `candidateState.publishedHead` equal to the head. On the next work step this function returns null, `existingHeadContinuationShape` is false, and the preserved-null refusal defers forever, so those rows still cannot republish. Allow the live-branch retired state to reopen a PR, or persist a durable closed-publication marker before dropping `target.pr`.

src/repair/loop-existing-head-continuation.ts:119-122

[P2] Clear stale checkpoint on deleted-branch restart

On this deleted-branch restart the target reset leaves `checkpoint` unchanged while setting `head` and `publishedHead` to null. `prepareImplementationStart` refreshes an issue base only when `head`, `checkpoint`, `pr`, and intent are all null, so a row that carried a candidate checkpoint will start the fresh attempt against a stale `target.base`. Clear `checkpoint` in this reset so the restart is actually based on the current base.

src/repair/loop-existing-head-continuation.ts:179-184

summary: Found two liveness/restart defects in the new closed-publication lane: retired preserved-null rows still dead-end, and deleted-branch restarts can reuse a stale base because the checkpoint is retained. The lane is otherwise implemented and exercised by tests, so the task is functionally addressed.

evidence: Added recoverClosedExistingHead at src/repair/loop-existing-head-continuation.ts:111-192; it verifies a retained closed unmerged PR, creates a replacement from the exact live head, or resets a deleted branch.
Matrix planner invokes recovery before readiness filtering at src/host/matrix-planner.ts:530-558, and serial work invokes it before the preserved-null refusal at src/repair/loop-work.ts:138-142.
tests/repair/loop-closed-existing-head_test.ts covers ai.ubq.fi PR 1149 replacement, missing publishedHead, deleted-branch restart, identity refusals, and ambiguous create reconciliation.
